title.narrative: Agriculture and Rural Development Project Phase 2

description.narrative: The project will be aligned with the following impact: competitiveness and sustainability of Mongolia's agriculture sector improved.[1] The outcome of the project will be value addition on Mongolian agricultural resources increased by project participating enterprises (PPE).[2] The project is expected to enhance technology adoption of agro-enterprise, to increase primarily the agro-processing capacity and secondly agricultural production in Mongolia, and hence increase value addition to agricultural resources. The increased capacity will lead to employment generation, and indirectly benefit herders, farmers, and primary processors through the PPEs' increased demand for raw materials.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Capacity of enterprises and service providers improved Indicator: (JSF) At least 636 PPE staff, of which at least 50% are female, are trained, including in opportunities to address climate change, and report improved technical skills Progress/Status: The TOR for the TA consulting firm, which will support delivery of training and capacity-building activities for PPE staff under Output 1, is currently under review by MOFALI. PPEs will first be identified before capacity-building needs are assessed and training activities are rolled out. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and TA progress reports Actual value:

Output: Capacity of enterprises and service providers improved Indicator: (JSF) At least three institutional or policy measures supporting value chain and green financing submitted to the MOF for approval and testing, including gender-responsive measures Progress/Status: The TOR for the TA consulting firm, which includes support for green financing and value chain financing initiatives, is currently under review by MOFALI. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and policy document produced and reviewed by the stakeholders Actual value:

Output: Capacity of enterprises and service providers improved Indicator: (JSF) Food safety and traceability standard practices improved for at least 10 PPEs Progress/Status: The TOR for the TA consulting firm, which will support training and technical assistance on food safety, traceability, and quality standards, is currently under review by MOFALI. Data Source: Quarterly project reports and certificates received from an accredited certification body Actual value:

Output: Capacity of enterprises and service providers improved Indicator: At least 1,000 representatives from business entities have been provided with the PMU's business advisory services Progress/Status: Twenty prospective enterprises have received business advisory support from the PIU, including guidance on preparing bankable proposals. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and TA progress reports Actual value:

Output: Capacity of enterprises and service providers improved Indicator: At least three Mongolian enterprises sell products to new export markets Progress/Status: The TOR for the TA consulting firm, which will support export promotion and market development activities under Output 1, is currently under review by MOFALI. Data Source: PPEs' implementation and monitoring reports and TA progress reports Actual value:

Output: Production capacity of herders and farmers improved Indicator: (JSF) At least 1,000 herders and farmers will be integrated in efficient value chains with about 30 PPEs Progress/Status: TA consulting firm TOR under MOFALI review Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports from the PMU; PPEs' contracts with farmers Actual value:

Output: Production capacity of herders and farmers improved Indicator: (JSF) Herders' and farmers' cooperatives supported by the project increase their supply of raw material incremental volume to domestic processing companies by at least 20% Progress/Status: TA consulting firm TOR under MOFALI review Data Source: Cooperative survey and/or quarterly project progress reports from PMU Actual value:

Output: Production capacity of herders and farmers improved Indicator: . (JSF) At least 1,500 of herders, farmers, primary processors, and relevant technical staff of local governments, of which at least 40% are women, trained and report improved skills on climate-resilient and low-emission production and quality control management Progress/Status: TA consulting firm TOR under MOFALI review Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports from the PMU; survey of participants Actual value:

Output: Value chain investments enhanced Indicator: (JSF) At least 45 PPEs increase purchase of quality raw materials by at least 20% Progress/Status: VCI proposals will be prepared by prospective enterprises following the signing of onlending agreements in July 2026. Financing of eligible subprojects will support increased purchases of quality raw materials from farmers and herders. Data Source: PPEs' implementation and monitoring reports, contracts with raw material producers, and financial statements through quarterly project progress reports from the PMU Actual value:

Output: Value chain investments enhanced Indicator: At least 30 PPEs integrate farmers in efficient value chains Progress/Status: VCI proposals are being prepared by prospective enterprises following the signing of onlending agreements in July 2026. Subproject investments are expected to strengthen value chain linkages between PPEs and farmers. Data Source: PPEs' implementation and monitoring reports, contracts with raw material producers, and financial statements through quarterly project progress reports from the PMU Actual value:

Output: Value chain investments enhanced Indicator: At least 45 VCI loans provided to PPEs, of which at least three are cooperatives, based on a clear climate change adaptation rationale Progress/Status: Onlending agreements were finalized and signed in July 2026. Submission of the first VCI proposals is targeted for August 2026, followed by due diligence review in September 2026, and then disbursement in October 2026. Data Source: Signed subloan agreements from the PMU Actual value:

Output: Value chain investments enhanced Indicator: Due diligence of about 50 VCI subprojects is completed Progress/Status: Twenty prospective enterprises have received guidance on preparation of bankable proposals. Data Source: Due diligence documents of the VCI subprojects from the PMU Actual value:

Output: Value chain investments enhanced Indicator: PPEs increase storage capacity by at least 3,000 square meters Progress/Status: VCI proposals are being prepared by prospective enterprises following the signing of onlending agreements in July 2026. Eligible investments may include expansion of storage and processing facilities. Data Source: PPEs' implementation and monitoring reports, contracts with raw material producers, and financial statements through quarterly project progress reports from the PMU Actual value:

Data Source: PPEs' implementation and monitoring reports and TA progress reports Actual value:
